dedupe_keys.name: flopros global database of flood protection standards

description: FLOPROS is the first global database of flood protection standards, published in 2016 in Natural Hazards and Earth System Sciences, to address the lack of information on existing protection in global flood risk models. It gives the flood return period associated with protection measures at different spatial scales in three layers combined into one database: a design layer with empirical information on the actual standard of existing protection, a policy layer with standards taken from policy regulations, and a model layer that computes standards with a validated modelling approach; the policy and model layers act as proxies to widen coverage. The authors describe it as evolving and invite the flood risk community to contribute. Coverage is global. Access is free as a journal supplement with a version 1 shapefile and an Excel file of the design and policy layers, under the journal's CC BY 4.0 licence. Caveats: this is version 1 from 2016, and outside the design layer the values are proxies from policy or modelling, not observed protection. Simulation uses: setting levee protection levels in flood risk and damage models for water, energy and transport assets. Related records: WRI Aqueduct (data-wri-aqueduct-water-risk-atlas) and the global floods and droughts collection (data-global-datasets-floods-droughts-human-interactions-collection).
